Mullaperiyar Dam Dispute: Tamil Nadu Accuses Kerala of Misleading Supreme Court

Tamil Nadu has informed the Supreme Court that Kerala misled the court regarding permission for felling trees near the Mullaperiyar dam's baby dam. The Tamil Nadu government stated that Kerala has been obstructive, attempting to delay the grant of permission for transporting grouting materials and machinery. This submission was made in the ongoing dispute over strengthening the Mullaperiyar dam.
